description: Alice reload timeout traced to native Chrome process crashes in disposable incognito test contexts; persistent actor profiles pass unchanged application protocol.
scope: Test launcher repair; no change to application readiness or reference encoding.

controlledChange.limitation: Precise native Chrome crash cause has not been established.
